name: Progress
description: Linear progress: determinate, indeterminate or segmented into steps, with an optional label and value above the track.

props.name: value
props.description: The progress, from 0 to max. Clamped. Ignored while indeterminate.

props.name: max
props.description: The value at completion. With segmented, the number of segments.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Progress is happening but its amount isn't known: a short bar slides along the track. Emitted as data-indeterminate; aria-valuenow is left out.
props.a11y: No aria-valuenow, so assistive technology reports it as indeterminate.

props.name: segmented
props.description: Splits the track into max segments, value of them done (data-done), for a few discrete steps. Emitted as data-segmented.

props.name: size
props.description: The track's height: 4, 6 or 10px. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: color
props.description: The bar's color. Emitted as data-color. Use error only when something is wrong.

props.name: label
props.description: What's progressing, shown above the track and naming the progressbar (aria-labelledby). Without it, name the progressbar with aria-label.

props.name: valueText
props.description: The value in words, such as 8 of 12: shown at the end of the head and read as aria-valuetext. Without it, a labelled bar shows the percentage.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { label: '…', bar: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The progressbar (role=progressbar) with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow.

parts.name: head
parts.description: The label and the value, above the track.

parts.name: value
parts.description: The value: valueText, or the percentage.

parts.name: track
parts.description: The track, with a 1px edge so it shows at 3:1. Segmented, it lays out the segments.

parts.name: bar
parts.description: The filled part, its width written inline as --apui-_v. Segmented, one bar per segment, the done ones marked data-done.

requirements: role=progressbar with aria-valuemin=0, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow; aria-valuenow is left out while indeterminate.
Named by its label (aria-labelledby) or by aria-label; valueText is read as aria-valuetext.
The track has an edge so it's visible at 3:1 on every surface.
The bar fills, and the indeterminate bar slides, in the reading direction; the animation stops under reduced motion.
